test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following has become the first woman officer to take over as the Director General, Armed Forces Medical Services, in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arti Sarin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arti Sarin** has created history by becoming the first woman officer to take over as the **Director General of the Armed Forces Medical Services (DG AFMS)** in **October 2024**.
 
• This achievement marks a **significant milestone** for women in the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The **Armed Forces Medical Services** (AFMS) is responsible for the medical care of armed forces personnel, and this is one of the **highest ranks** in the organization.
 
• Her appointment highlights the growing role of **women in leadership positions** in the defense forces.
 
• **Arti Sarin** is known for her outstanding contributions to the field of military medicine and has served in various critical roles during her career.
 
• This achievement reflects the **progressive steps** taken by the Indian Armed Forces towards promoting **gender equality**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Anju Rathi Rana**__

 __
 
• **Anju Rathi Rana** is a well-known name in the Indian defense sector, but she has not been appointed as the **Director General of AFMS**.
 
• She has contributed significantly to the **administrative and operational aspects** of the armed forces.
 
 
 
• **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar**__
 __
 
• **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar** is a prominent Indian politician and social activist.
 
• She has been associated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and served as the **Chairperson of the Maharashtra State Commission for Women**.
 
• Her work primarily focuses on **women's empowerment** and social reforms, not military services.
 
 
 
• **Deena Mehta**__
 
 
• **Deena Mehta** is a distinguished figure in the Indian financial sector.
 
• She was the **first woman president of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)**.
 
• Her expertise lies in **finance and stock market operations**, not in the armed forces.
